status: frozen-draft (Lead); changes require contract revision + revalidation of affected gates
scope_note: This is a named Spikformer NLP integer variant, NOT bit-identical to upstream Spikformer: no softmax, unnormalized AV, no BN/LayerNorm, exactly two added branch-output LIFs (proj, fc2).
dataflow: block: Q/K/V linear+bias -> LIF(q/k/v); per head & per t QK popcount (AND, no /head_dim) -> score; AV[a][t] = sum_j score[i][j][t]*V[j][a][t] (unnormalized); proj(AV) -> LIF(proj); residual add; fc1 -> LIF(fc1); fc2 -> LIF(fc2); residual add
head: PL per-channel sum over T*N -> PS divide T*N -> FP32 Linear+bias -> argmax

numeric.weights: signed int8, per-tensor symmetric scale = maxabs/127; zero scale -> 1.0; range [-127,127]
numeric.bias: signed int32 in the integer accumulator domain
numeric.accum: signed 32-bit for every linear stage; bounds checked at export time against actual tensors

lif.add_semantics: sign-extend pre and delta to 33 bit BEFORE add; never wrap at 32 bit
lif.init: pre=0 at t=0 of every token/channel; no leak across tokens/samples/blocks

qk.per: head dim 32 AND-popcount, per t, same head; no division

av.formula: sum over 32 source tokens of score(0..32) * V_spike(0/1)

qkv.note: pos/neg above are for block0 spike input (0/1). Block>0 input is the previous residual (max 3 at block1 input for depth2): worst qkv = 3*127*128=48768 / -3*128*128=-49152, still int32. The exporter must compute the actual per-block bound from the real input domain and bias and error if int32 is exceeded; the fixed numbers here are contract sanity minima.

proj.note: AV max 1024 x weight 127/ -128 x 128 inputs

head.pl: uint32 per-channel sum over T*N=128 samples; no divide in PL
head.ps: x/(T*N) in FP32 then W@x+b then argmax

numeric.mask: none (fixed seq 32); PAD=0, UNK=1 are ordinary ids, no mask, no zero-spike guarantee
numeric.downshift_policy: no low-bit truncation of continuous accumulators into the residual; LIF outputs feed residuals

hardware_abi.notes: Ports frozen 2026-10-29 19:40 by Lead after contract read; replay TBs, generated target adapter and all RTL owners must match exactly. o_out_valid may be registered but must be valid only with stable data; handshake is valid&&ready.
sample_sequence: i_start single-cycle pulse (top then leaves reset-like idle state? no: weights persist not guaranteed, full reload per sample)
i_tab_*: 64-bit words; etab row-major V*E bytes (V*E/8 beats), then ptab row-major N*E bytes (N*E/8 beats)
i_tok_*: N beats of 16-bit token id

per block b=0..DEPTH-1: 4 descriptor beats then WBEATS weight beats (see below), then top runs block b, expects 512 block-in beats produced internally from captured spikes, collects 512 block-out beats
descriptor_beats_64b: beat3 = {32'h0, thr_e[31:0]}; meaningful only for block 0, ignored for b>0
hardware_abi.weight_beat_format: 64-bit = 8 consecutive signed int8 in row-major [out][in] order
hardware_abi.bias_beat_format: 64-bit = {bias[2m+1][31:0], bias[2m][31:0]} signed int32; NOT a 20-bit field
hardware_abi.handshake: one beat consumed iff valid && ready in the same cycle; payload stable while stalled; counters advance only on valid&&ready; no ready-ahead-of-valid implicit contract
hardware_abi.block_in_out_beat_format: TL=8 lanes x T=4 timeslices x RW=4 bits = 128 bit; lane-major {(a*T+tt+1)*RW-1 -: RW}
hardware_abi.block_sees_only_its_own_thresholds: current block thresholds loaded from descriptor; stable during its run

hierarchical_monitor_names.note: frozen for read-only TB monitors (replay only reads; RTL must keep names)

hardware_abi.head_sums_definition: o_sums[c] = sum over n=0..TOKENS-1, t=0..T-1 of the LAST block's output value out[n][c][t] (RW-bit unsigned residual, 0..1+2*depth); PL does no divide; PS computes x=o_sums/(T*N) then FP32 head W@x+b then argmax. o_sums_valid pulses once per sample together with o_done.
hardware_abi.top_sequencing_detail: External port order stays EXACTLY tables -> tokens -> per-block descriptor -> per-block weights. Internally spikformer_nlp_top buffers the N token ids, latches thr_e from block0 descriptor beat3, feeds the buffered tokens to u_emb during the block0 weight-load phase (embed encode may overlap block0 weight load), and starts block0 only after BOTH block0 weights are fully accepted AND the embed capture into tbuf is complete. Exactly one encode per sample.
hardware_abi.done_valid_semantics: o_sums_valid and o_done are LEVEL signals held from sample completion until the next i_start pulse (exactly one assertion per sample); they are not 1-cycle pulses. TBs may sample sums when o_done=1 (and before the next i_start).

storage.etab: inferred synchronous-read RAM, 64-bit words, V*E bytes=512000; address = token_id*(E/8)+group; one-cycle read latency with result-hold alignment
storage.qkv_proj: 8 banks per matrix (bank=output lane TL), each bank (E/TL)*(E/TC) entries x 64-bit (8 int8 input weights per entry); one 64-bit sync read per bank per cycle; only selected bank written during load
storage.fc1_fc2: one 64-bit synchronous-read RAM each (HIDDEN*E=65536 bytes, E*HIDDEN=65536 bytes); sequential beat address from the tile stream; no systolic-array replacement this batch
storage.small_buffers: bias/threshold/control/feature caches may stay in registers; large RAMs must have no per-element reset
storage.av_reduction: source-token dimension accumulated one token per cycle (one small adder bank), NOT 32 combinational adds per cycle
storage.tc8_reduce: balanced adder tree; if a register stage is needed, valid/output-group/input-tile/last-tile travel with it; wait for real completion before firing LIF

export_abi.param_blob_mapping: compile/weights.py maps etab->embed_w, ptab->pos_w RTL blobs; per-block thresholds+scales and head_w/head_b are exported into params/ + manifest so the runtime package binds them (thresholds are streamed as descriptor beats; head stays PS FP32).

verification_ladder: integer math/interface short tests (one-hot cross token/t, negative accum, popcount=32, AV=1024, LIF threshold edges): PyTorch-quantized forward vs independent NumPy
small int chain E32/H1/T2/seq4/depth2: one embed->2 blocks->sum replay; two blocks different weights/thresholds; two consecutive samples without global reset
multi-head short E64/H2/seq4 single block: two heads, distinct spikes, no cross-head leakage (then stop)

target E128/H4/T4/seq32/depth2: fixed short sentences/different lengths, >=2 consecutive samples, compare every output beat/number/order/last/done; add reproducible input bubbles and output backpressure
final real params: 1-3 fixed samples, target RTL vs integer golden beat-exact; head logits/class match PS
